meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Hostinger Review 2026: Pricing, Speed Test, AI Tools
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Hostinger review for 2026: plan and renewal prices, a nine-day speed and uptime test from All About Cookies, AI tools, the Black Friday offer, pros and cons.
meta.rl_answer: Hostinger is a low-cost host with fast results in a named test and a long AI list. It needs a 48-month term for the sale price, and renewals cost more.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Hostinger good? | All About Cookies reported 100% uptime over 9 days and a 138 ms average response time. It also noted that Hostinger is not PCI compliant and that renewals cost more.
How much does Hostinger cost? | Premium is $1.99 a month on a 48-month term and renews at $10.99 a month, according to Hostinger's own pages.
Is Hostinger good for WordPress? | In the All About Cookies test, a paid plan scored 99 out of 100 on page speed from three locations.
Is Hostinger legit? | Hostinger is an established host with a 30-day money-back guarantee listed. Read the term and renewal price before you buy.
Does Hostinger have AI features? | It lists an AI website builder, AI credits, an AI assistant called Hostinger Agent and an MCP server. We did not test them.
Is Hostinger good for an online store? | All About Cookies notes that Hostinger is not PCI compliant. If you take card payments on the site, check how your payment provider handles that.
